mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, plan_id, status, review_mode, mode, user_id, section_total, section_done, total_score, grade, summary, file_hash, model_name, prompt_version, token_input, token_output, duration_ms, error_msg, created_by, create_time, update_time, end_time FROM ai_review_task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, project_id, plan_id, status, review_mode, mode, user_id, section_total, section_done, total_score, grade, summary, file_hash, model_name, prompt_version, token_input, token_output, duration_ms, error_msg, created_by, create_time, update_time, end_time FROM ai_review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, project_id, plan_id, status, review_mode, mode, user_id, section_total, section_done, total_score, grade, summary, file_hash, model_name, prompt_version, token_input, token_output, duration_ms, error_msg, created_by, create_time, update_time, end_time FROM ai_review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PARSING', 'REVIEWING', 'SUMMARIZING') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_review_task (project_id, plan_id, status, review_mode, section_total, section_done, created_by, create_time, user_id, mode) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{planId}, #{status}, #{reviewMode}, #{sectionTotal}, #{sectionDone}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{userId}, #{mode})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_review_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_review_task SET status = #{status}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_review_task SET section_done = #{sectionDone}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_review_task SET status = #{status}, section_total = #{sectionTotal}, section_done = #{sectionDone}, total_score = #{totalScore}, grade = #{grade}, summary = #{summary}, file_hash = #{fileHash}, model_name = #{modelName}, prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, token_input = #{tokenInput}, token_output = #{tokenOutput}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_review_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
